theorems.name: Submission.doragm_sab_annulus_increment_sandwich
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q F : Euclid P → ℝ) (A s t : ℝ), 1 < A → 0 < s → s ≤ t → Antitone φ → (∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u ∧ φ u ≤ 1) → (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) → (∀ x, s < ‖x - y‖ → F x = q x) → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x) μ → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x) μ → 0 ≤ (∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x ∂μ ∧ (∫⁻ x in closedBall y t \ closedBall y (A * s), ENNReal.ofReal (F x) ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x ∂μ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * q x ∂μ) - ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * q x ∂μ) ≤ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y (A * t) \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (F x) ∂μ
